description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the AbstractEndpoint class within the OrangeHRM API Core plugin. It defines tests for endpoint request gathering, parameter validation (sorting, pagination, filtering), and setting request parameters, ensuring the correct behavior and validation logic of the API endpoint abstraction.

classes.name: AbstractEndpointTest
classes.description: Test class for OrangeHRM's AbstractEndpoint functionality within the API, focusing on request setup, parameter validation, and method behavior verification.

methods.name: testEndpoint
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of request, request parameters, and validation decorator from the endpoint.

methods.name: testGetSortingAndPaginationParamsRules
methods.description: Verifies the number of parameter rules for sorting and pagination with different input configurations.

methods.name: getSortingAndPaginationParamsRules
methods.description: Helper method to invoke the protected method for retrieving sorting and pagination parameter rules.

methods.name: testSortOrderParamsRules
methods.description: Tests validation of the 'sortOrder' parameter with valid and invalid inputs.

methods.name: testLimitParamsRules
methods.description: Validates the 'limit' parameter with various acceptable values.

methods.name: testLimitParamsRulesExceptions
methods.description: Ensures invalid 'limit' values throw an InvalidParamException.

methods.name: limitParamsRulesExceptionDataProvider
methods.description: Provides invalid data sets for testing limit parameter exceptions.

methods.name: testOffsetParamsRules
methods.description: Validates the 'offset' parameter with acceptable values.

methods.name: testOffsetParamsRulesExceptions
methods.description: Ensures invalid 'offset' values throw an InvalidParamException.

methods.name: offsetParamsRulesExceptionDataProvider
methods.description: Provides invalid data sets for testing offset parameter exceptions.

methods.name: sortFieldParamsRulesExceptionDataProvider
methods.description: Provides invalid data sets for testing sortField parameter exceptions.

methods.name: testSetRequestParams
methods.description: Tests setting request parameters on the endpoint.

methods.name: testSetSortingAndPaginationParams
methods.description: Verifies that setting sorting and pagination parameters updates FilterParams correctly.

methods.name: setSortingAndPaginationParamsDataProvider
methods.description: Provides data sets for testing setting of sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getMockEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a mock instance of the Endpoint class with optional query parameters.
